card.name: One per each, or one at a time
card.fires_on: The distributive words "each" and "time" (and "different" after "a") in phrases like "one for each", "one in each hand" and "one at a time", where a single item is paired with each unit.

modes.label: one ... each
modes.description: "each" after "one for/in/on" assigns one item to every member of a set.

modes.label: at a time
modes.description: "time" ending "only one ... at a time" limits how many are used together.
modes.example: Only one patch should be worn at a<< time>>.

modes.label: a different (one per day)
modes.description: "different" after "each day a" says a new item appears in turn.
modes.example: Each day a<< different>> image or photograph of our fascinating universe is
